arxiv-2206-09583.title: Rebalance and Smear for Multi-jet Background Estimation
arxiv-2206-09583.creator: Christian Sander
arxiv-2206-09583.description: Abstract For many particle collider searches for physics beyond the Standard Model in final states with jets and missing transverse momentum, events from QCD multi-jet processes are an important and challenging background contribution. The CMS and ATLAS experiments have previously developed data-driven methods designed to succeed where Monte Carlo methods suffer large theoretical and experimental uncertainties.

arxiv-2303-02317.creator: Zafar Ahmad, Reilly Browne, Rezaul Chowdhury, Rathish Das, Yushen Huang, Yimin Zhu
arxiv-2303-02317.description: Abstract . We study the binomial, trinomial, and Black-Scholes-Merton models of option pricing. We present fast parallel discrete-time finite-difference algorithms for American call option pricing under the binomial and trinomial models and American put option pricing under the Black-Scholes-Merton model.

arxiv-2306-13660.title: Statistical relational learning and neuro-symbolic AI: what does first-order logic offer?
arxiv-2306-13660.creator: Vaishak Belle
arxiv-2306-13660.description: Abstract In this paper, our aim is to briefly survey and articulate the logical and philosophical foundations of using (first-order) logic to represent (probabilistic) knowledge in a non-technical fashion. Our motivation is three fold. First, for machine learning researchers unaware of why the research community cares about relational representations, this article can serve as a gentle introduction.

arxiv-2503-02078.creator: Jonathan Jacobi, Gal Niv
arxiv-2503-02078.description: Abstract Understanding and interpreting the internal representations of large language models (LLMs) remains an open challenge. Patchscopes ( Ghandeharioun et al. (2024) ) introduced a method for probing internal activations by patching them into new prompts, prompting models to self-explain their hidden representations.

arxiv-2509-08368.title: Diameter-Controlled High-Order Vortex States and Magnon Hybridization in VSe 2 Nanotubes
arxiv-2509-08368.creator: Jia-Wen Li, Xin-Wei Yi, Jin Zhang, Gang Su, Bo Gu
arxiv-2509-08368.description: Abstract Curved magnets offer a rich phase diagram and hold great promise for next-generation spintronic technologies. This study establishes the paramount significance of high-order vortex states (e.g., 3 ​ φ 3\varphi with winding number n ≥ 2 n\geq 2 ) in VSe 2 \text{VSe}_{2} nanotubes, which uniquely enable magnonic functionalities fundamentally inaccessible to conventional magnetic systems.

pmc-11530134.title: GCN2 kinase activation mediates pulmonary vascular remodeling and pulmonary arterial hypertension
pmc-11530134.creator: Maggie M Zhu, Jingbo Dai, Zhiyu Dai, Yi Peng, You-Yang Zhao
pmc-11530134.description: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) is characterized by progressive increase of pulmonary vascular resistance and remodeling that result in right heart failure. Recessive mutations of EIF2AK4 gene (encoding general control nonderepressible 2 kinase, GCN2) are linked to heritable pulmonary veno-occlusive disease (PVOD) in patients but rarely in patients with PAH.

pmc-11650582.title: Liver-targeting iron oxide nanoparticles and their complexes with plant extracts for biocompatibility
pmc-11650582.creator: Shushanik A Kazaryan, Seda A Oganian, Gayane S Vardanyan, Anatolie S Sidorenko, Ashkhen A Hovhannisyan, Kerstin Koch
pmc-11650582.description: Thanks to their simple synthesis, controlled physical properties, and minimal toxicity, iron oxide nanoparticles (Fe3O4 NPs) are widely used in many biomedical applications (e.g., bioimaging, drug delivery, biosensors, diagnostics, and theranostics). However, the use of NPs does not preclude the possibility of selective toxicity and undesirable effects, including accumulation in tissues and direct interaction with specific biological targets.

pmc-13080118.title: Comparison of Braided and Nonbraided Hamstring Tendon Grafts in ACL Reconstruction: Impact on Graft Thickness, Rerupture Rates, and Clinical Outcomes
pmc-13080118.creator: Nihat Demirhan Demirkıran, Gustavo Vinagre, Süleyman Kaan Öner, Umur Batak, Gonzalo Samitier Solís
pmc-13080118.description: Purpose:To compare braided and nonbraided hamstring tendon grafts in anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) reconstruction, specifically examining graft thickness, rerupture rates, and clinical outcomes, in order to assess whether braided grafts offer measurable advantages.Study Design:Cohort study; Level of evidence, 3.Methods:This retrospective study included 154 patients who underwent single-bundle ACL reconstruction between January 2017 and October 2022.

pmc-13324719.title: Supervised contrastive learning for cell stage classification of animal embryos
pmc-13324719.creator: Yasmine Hachani, Patrick Bouthemy, Elisa Fromont, Sylvie Ruffini, Ludivine Laffont, Alline de Paula Reis
pmc-13324719.description: Video microscopy, when combined with machine learning, offers a promising approach for studying the early development of in vitro produced (IVP) embryos. However, manually annotating developmental events, and more specifically cell divisions, is time-consuming for a biologist and cannot scale up for practical applications.

pmc-13655468.title: Incidence Rate and Factors Associated with Antiretroviral Therapy Regimen Change among Adult HIV Patients at Ngoerah Hospital Bali, Indonesia
pmc-13655468.creator: I Ketut Agus Somia, I Made Susila Utama, Anak Agung Ayu Yuli Gayatri, Ni Made Dewi Dian Sukmawati, Cokorda Agung Wahyu Purnamasidhi
pmc-13655468.description: BackgroundThe human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) epidemic remains a major global health concern. While antiretroviral therapy (ART) has significantly improved survival rates, regimen changes during long-term treatment are common and may impact clinical outcomes. Data regarding the incidence rate and determinants of ART regimen changes among people living with HIV (PLHIV) in Bali, Indonesia, remain limited.
